attempts.name: BF16 checkpoint with BNB NF4 double quantization
BF16 LoRA with single-process balanced layer placement on 8 GPUs

conclusion: The available BF16 checkpoint did not pass the single-L20 load gate with standard BNB NF4. The same BF16 model completed a 60-step LoRA validation on eight L20 GPUs with single-process balanced layer placement, but no blind-test score is reported for the 30B run.
next_validation: Run the fixed 110-example blind test for Base and Adapter before claiming a behavior-quality gain.
Compare the capacity-first device-map run with FSDP, ZeRO-3 efficient initialization, or Megatron Expert Parallel.
Use a complete pre-quantized GPTQ or AWQ checkpoint for the single-GPU path.
limitations: Each path has one repetition, so timings are not a throughput benchmark.
The eight-GPU success uses single-process layer placement, not data parallelism or expert parallelism; GPU execution is largely sequential across layers.
The GPTQ path was not evaluated because the available checkpoint copy contained no weight shards.
The 30B run completed training and validation loss evaluation but did not run the blind generation A/B, so no behavior score is imputed.
